//canonifyURLs: Deliberately unset. It rewrites URLs absolute against baseURL, so on www the stylesheet is cross-origin, colours.html cannot read its @keyframes rule, and the whole theme renders white.
//taxonomies: Replaces the legacy `indexes` key, which Hugo still honours as an alias. Removing it entirely re-enables the default categories taxonomy and generates empty /categories/ pages.
